elements.name: Harness Interface Endpoint
elements.note: TLS 1.3 loopback listener, POST-only MCP endpoint, header and body bounds, Host and Origin checks; per-source rate limits and lockout on the OAuth and session endpoints (internal/authguard). No UDS listener, no Remote Access listener, no per-source connection limits on the MCP endpoint.

elements.name: Protocol Mediator
elements.note: Both protocol eras through the MCP Go SDK in stateless mode, method allowlist, cache hints, Appendix B codes with reasonCode, correlationId and decisionId. No progress relay, no data.message text (FR-1.51), no hold-mode keep-alives.

elements.name: Identity & Authentication Service
elements.note: OAuth 2.1 authorization server (metadata, PKCE S256, resource, iss), pre-registered clients, Argon2id. Sign-in by Session Approver accounts; the Administrator is refused. Rate limits, lockout with backoff, bounded concurrent Argon2id and dummy verification for unknown accounts; the sign-in page denies framing. client_id_metadata_document_supported is not advertised. No metadata document fetching, DCR or mTLS.

elements.name: Session Manager
elements.note: Session store with lifetimes, per-principal limits, scope-to-template mapping, session API and refresh. Refresh tokens rotate on every refresh and a reused one revokes the session; janitors prune ended sessions and expired codes. Sessions do not survive restart; no taint tracking.

elements.name: Policy Administration Service
elements.note: Schema-validated policy file compiled at startup. No signed Policy Store, publication, simulation, rollback or revision history.

elements.name: Policy Decision Service
elements.note: Default-deny decisions over the compiled snapshot, approval obligation flag, sliding-window rate limits, decision IDs. No argument predicates, deny rules, explanations, secret-use or anomaly obligations.

elements.name: Approval Service
elements.note: Not started. The pipeline.Approver seam exists; its default refuses an approval-obligated call with -31002 and retry text, and the control API has a placeholder approvals route. No approval records, hold mode, CLI decisions, console or notification.

elements.name: Access Enforcement Point
elements.note: Session-scoped catalog per policy revision, unknown-tool rejection, approval hint (FR-1.50). No metadata scan at presentation.

elements.name: Request Inspection Pipeline
elements.note: Ordered request filter chain with mandatory and policy-obliged optional filters; schema-validate is the only filter and runs first. No path, URL, secret, injection or Unicode filters; no versioned rule sets.

elements.name: Tool Dispatcher
elements.note: stdio dispatch with concurrency and queue bounds, upstream timeout, result size bound and backend error mapping. Instances are shared across sessions; no cancellation propagation or progress relay.

elements.name: Response Inspection Pipeline
elements.note: Result size bound and provenance metadata marking results untrusted. No content filters, output-schema validation or delimiting.

elements.name: Enforcement Coordinator
elements.note: One-use launch capability bound to correlation, decision, policy revision and tool, checked by the dispatcher; pre-launch and pre-release rechecks under the barrier; emergency stop through the control API. The authorized event is committed with fsync before the capability is issued and delivered is committed before release. SR-6.2-1 stays partial until the graph mirror (E-26) exists.

elements.name: Library Trust Verifier
elements.note: No package verification or smcpctl package commands; tools are read from live backends at startup.

elements.name: Local Server Registry
elements.note: In-memory registry from the live tool list: public-name derivation, collision refusal, tool definition validity checks. No manifests, enablement states, drift suspension or artifact cache.

elements.name: Server Runtime Manager
elements.note: Launches configured commands as child processes through the pipeline.Launcher seam, with an environment allowlist and bounded stderr capture. Commands must be absolute paths; package runners such as npx and uvx and undigested container images are refused. The bootstrap example runs the bundled read-only smcp-refserver. No signed packages or confining launcher.

elements.name: Execution Sandbox
elements.note: No sandbox; backends run unconfined.

elements.name: Audit & Evidence Service
elements.note: Mandatory event floor to signed, hash-chained JSON Lines segments with group-committed fsync, crash recovery that seals an open segment, a signed anchor that detects deleted trailing segments, and the smcpctl journal verify checker. A failed write fails the endpoint closed with AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE. audit.Fanout passes events to non-blocking observers. No graph mirror feed, export or key transitions.

elements.name: Key & Trust Anchor Manager
elements.note: Local CA name-constrained to loopback names (2-year lifetime) and listener certificate (397 days, reissued at startup when near expiry), Ed25519 evidence key, operator token, Argon2id hashing. Lifetimes exceed CP-53 (CA 1 year, listener 90 days); keys are 0600 files without TPM, Keychain or passphrase; no trust anchors or key rotation.

elements.name: Health & Safety Monitor
elements.note: GET /healthz and the control API health route report fail-closed for emergency stop or a missing snapshot, the profile (Standalone reports degraded: unconfined and the label not enforced) and unverified manifests; high-risk servers are refused in Standalone. slog diagnostic log. No periodic checks or metrics.

elements.name: Management Console & Control API
elements.note: smcpctl bootstrap (prompt, password files or one-use token), config validate, journal verify, hash-password, health, stop, resume, policy reload, approvals and admin redeem; control API on a separate loopback listener with login, bootstrap redemption, health, stop, resume, policy reload and an approvals placeholder; TOML configuration validated against a JSON Schema. No console, install, upgrade or backup commands.

elements.name: Harness Adapter Kit
elements.note: No smcp-session, smcp-stdio, smcp-connect, doctor or lockdown profiles.
